upbringing.label: Family / Chapter One
upbringing.title: Raised in Konstantine Gamsakhurdia’s Household
upbringing.introduction: Zviad Gamsakhurdia was born in Tbilisi in 1939 to the writer and academician Konstantine Gamsakhurdia and Miranda Palavandishvili. His childhood unfolded inside a household closely connected with Georgian literature, historical memory and the preservation of national culture under Soviet rule.

sections.label: Household
sections.title: A Literary Home
paragraphs: Konstantine Gamsakhurdia was one of the central Georgian novelists of the twentieth century. Books, writers and the historical imagination were therefore part of the household’s ordinary environment.
This section can be expanded with verified information about the family home, its visitors, the books available to the children and the place of literature in everyday family life.

sections.label: Language and culture
sections.title: Language as Inheritance
paragraphs: The household presented Georgian language and literature not merely as academic subjects, but as forms of cultural continuity and responsibility.
This section can later contain fuller textual history, quotations from documented sources and photographs or manuscript material relevant to language, education and cultural memory.

sections.label: Formation
sections.title: Private Formation, Public Consequence
paragraphs: The themes that later defined Gamsakhurdia’s scholarship and politics—history, faith, national culture and moral duty—were already present in the world in which he grew up.
The purpose of this section is to connect the documented circumstances of his upbringing with later developments without presenting interpretation as established fact.
